description: .easeInOut(duration: 0.15) is a magic number repeated 11 times across 4 files (CondensedSidebar.swift, WorkspaceSidebar.swift, WorkspaceRow.swift, ContentView.swift) with no shared constant.
reason: Pre-existing codebase-wide pattern; adding a shared constant (e.g., Layout.sidebarCollapseAnimation) would require touching HoottyCore, which is out of scope for a view-layer change. Defer to a dedicated design-system cleanup pass.

description: WorkspaceRailRow receives isPinned: workspace.id == pinnedWorkspaceID — the pin knowledge leaks from parent to child. An alternative would be to compute iconName in the parent and pass a plain String.
reason: Judgment call; passing isPinned: Bool is the same pattern used in WorkspaceRow.swift:26 and mirrors the full sidebar's approach. The abstraction is consistent with the rest of the file. Not worth changing.

description: sortedWorkspaces computed property is only used once (in moveCursor) and re-derives pinnedWorkspace + scrollableWorkspaces, adding a third layer of derivation.
reason: Pre-existing pattern; not introduced or worsened by this blueprint. Negligible complexity at current workspace counts.
